messages:
eli: FYI CS-2345 — two customers reported sudden 401s after updating to client SDK v1.5.0. They see repeated retries and a billing spike. attaching repro steps
maya: ugh. is this the cross-sdk regen we ran last night?
eli: yes — regen CI pushed new generated clients for python/ts/go. support ticket shows failures started ~2026-03-14 03:22 UTC.
support: customer logs (redacted): 
```
2026-03-14T03:23:01Z ERROR request failed status=401 route=/v1/complete attempts=4 token_cost=5
2026-03-14T03:23:01Z INFO retrying after 200ms
```
sam: can you paste the minimal repro? curious if Authorization header is actually missing or upstream returning 401 for other reasons
eli: minimal repro from customer (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="sk-customer")
resp = c.completions.create(model="rwd-1", prompt="hello")
print(resp.status_code)
```
maya: that's normal. but in our generated client we recently added an interceptor chain — if header param order changed the auth middleware might run after the request body gets serialized and some gens add `content-type` logic that can clobber headers.
arya: I pulled a local trace. TS client 1.5.0 generator change reordered parameters for post requests: path params, then body, then headers. older clients expected headers earlier. In some codegen templates we rely on `headers` being the last arg and merge later — mismatch can drop Authorization into `undefined` and the runtime skips sending it.
toni: repro (curl) that shows missing header at outbound:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1","prompt":"hi"}'
# -> server sees no Authorization header
```
support: customers report 401 -> client retries (3x) and each attempt charged; net cost ~3x. they want mitigation ASAP.
maya: immediate mitigation: tell customers to pin previous client version 1.4.2. I'll open a hotfix branch to change generated template to keep header param merge stable.
sam: quick workaround we can ship — add a small wrapper in runtime that ensures `Authorization` is copied into `request.headers` before send, regardless of template ordering. low-risk patch.
eli: can we also add a CI test that runs the real auth flow against a test token for python/ts/go on regen to catch this?
deploy-bot: deploy check triggered for regen-ci -> failed unit tests in ts-client-generator (1 error)
maya: good — failing tests prevented a rollout to prod for some languages, but python and go already passed and rolled.
arya: I've got a local patch for the generator templates that normalizes header merging order. Will open PR and mark as hotfix.
toni: support ticket updated with rollback instructions + request to suspend auto-upgrade for existing customers.
eli: next steps: 1) maya to PR hotfix template (ETA 2h). 2) sam to prepare runtime wrapper patch and quick emergency release (1.5.1) for python/go. 3) arya to add regen-ci integration test to block generator changes that alter header handling. 4) support to notify impacted customers and offer credits.
support: notified customers + applied temporary rate limit exemption to avoid billing shock. they asked for a postmortem.
maya: will include changelog note and root cause analysis re: codegen param reordering. also adding explicit changelog entry for upgrades that could be breaking.
eli: thanks. adding reminder: we need better golden-sample tests for auth headers in cross-sdk regen. assigning follow-ups in JIRA: DEVEX-778 (hotfix), GEN-332 (regen-ci test), CS-2345 (customer comms).
sam: can someone paste the exact generator change/commit so I can reference it in the PR?
arya: commit id: d4f9b1e3 — template update: reorder-params -> I will link in PR.
eli: OK let's reconvene after hotfix PR. please add any further logs here. :eyes: :thumbsup:
